headline: S&P Says Lower Inflation Helps Turkish Banks Withstand Shocks
summary: Progress in reducing inflation is helping Turkish banks withstand global and regional shocks, keeping risks manageable despite high financing costs, according to S&P Global Ratings.
why: Turkish banks face complex macroeconomic conditions, and disinflation trends are vital for stabilising their funding costs and credit portfolios.

impacts.name: Turkish Banking
impacts.why: While easing inflation helps absorb shocks, elevated financing costs continue to pressure bank margins.
